text:
alex_m: Heads up — onboarding for Aurora (aws acct 123456789012) needs p5 + g5 capacity in eu-west-16. Can we kick off quota/entitlement requests? Baseline: 8 p5, 12 g5. Burst target: 24 GPUs. Also worried about ENI / EIP / SNAT limits. Target go-live next Mon.
cloud_ops: Got it. We need: exact instance types, AZ spread, whether it's prod, and a brief workload justification. p5 requires accelerator entitlement from AWS — that'll take extra time if not requested now.
samira: Confirming: prod workload, 3-AZ spread. Instance types: p5.24xlarge (inference) and g5.16xlarge (ops/rdt). Baseline numbers above are per-region. Can we also request dedicated EIP pool per AZ to avoid SNAT throttle?
raj: Quick checklist for the AWS support case:

```
Account: 123456789012
Region: eu-west-16
Instance families: p5 (p5.24xlarge), g5 (g5.16xlarge)
Requested limits: p5=8 -> 24 (burst), g5=12 -> 24 (burst)
Use case: low-latency inference fleet for production traffic; 24/7 usage
AZ spread: 3 AZs
Networking asks: ENI per AZ -> 500, Elastic IPs -> +30 per AZ, SNAT port guidance
Notes: Please escalate for accelerator entitlement for p5 family
```

Attach perf profile and cost/billing contact when opening case.
meera: Two networking notes: 1) SNAT port exhaustion is a real risk at this scale; recommend 2 NAT gateways per AZ + allocate multiple EIPs or use an egress-balancer. 2) If possible request IPv6 fallback for worker subnets — avoids hitting IPv4 EIP limits. Also reserve a /22 for the worker subnets now (we'll need ENI density).
quota-bot: Internal ticket created: INF-9876. Drafted AWS Support case in the console (case id: 000123456789). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu_quota_onboard (internal). Please paste final justification and billing contact.
alex_m: Thanks — I'll file the AWS case tonight and paste the case number here. Can someone from infra co-sign for priority please? @raj @meera :thumbsup:
raj: I can co-sign. Also flagging cost owner — initial monthly committed pool estimate ~ $85k (will add breakdown in PR).

samira: Adding the perf/traffic doc to INF-9876 now. I'll also ping AWS account manager to ask for expedited review.

alex_m: Perfect. Once AWS case is live I'll update infra ticket and create a small PR to reserve the subnets and update Terraform with desired ENI/EIP counts.
